context: Two students study group dynamics — when arguments start
purpose: Teach: 両者/筋肉/同僚/起こり/余計/ふたり/看板/椅子

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この前の勉強会、ふたりが急に言い争い始めて、空気がすごく重くなったよね。
lines.en: At the last study group, the two of them suddenly started arguing and the atmosphere got really heavy.
lines.style: Casual male university tone, slightly tired and observational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、両者譲らずって感じで、見てるこっちが疲れちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah, it was like neither side would back down, and watching it tired me out.
lines.style: Teenage girl, candid and slightly exasperated delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そもそも事の起こりは、誰がレジュメ作るかって話だったよね。うちって一応看板の勉強会なのに、そんな小さなことで揉めるなんてね。
lines.en: The whole thing started over who would make the handout. We're supposed to be the flagship study group, and yet they fought over something so small.
lines.style: Casual male, mildly critical and reflective tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 椅子をガタンって鳴らして立ち上がった時、私びっくりして体が固まっちゃって、肩の筋肉までガチガチになったよ。
lines.en: When he stood up and slammed the chair, I was so shocked my body froze up, even the muscles in my shoulders got all stiff.
lines.style: Teenage girl, animated and slightly dramatic recollection.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかる。あれは余計な一言が引き金だったと思う。冷静に話せばよかったのにね。
lines.en: I get it. I think that unnecessary remark was the trigger. They should have just talked it out calmly.
lines.style: Calm university male, thoughtful and analytical voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、ああいう時って、同僚っていうか仲間として、誰かが間に入った方がいいのかな?
lines.en: Hey, in moments like that, do you think someone, like a peer, should step in between?
lines.style: Teenage girl asking a genuine, curious question softly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 難しいなあ。下手に入ると余計こじれるし、かと言って放っておくと、もう元に戻れなくなりそうだし。
lines.en: That's tough. Step in clumsily and it gets even worse, but leave it alone and it feels like they won't be able to go back to how they were.
lines.style: Pensive male university student weighing both sides carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ次の集まりまでに、ふたりで仲直りしてくれるといいね。
lines.en: Then I hope the two of them make up before the next meeting.
lines.style: Teenage girl, gentle and hopeful closing remark.
